canonical_contracts.request_polarity: game+E9 bit2 SET requests retraction to object+9E=0; CLEAR requests deployment to0xFFFF. A request is distinct from actual word position.
canonical_contracts.motion: F1008 uses unsigned master_ticks>>1, saturating at the requested endpoint. Tick0/1 can leave position unchanged while other source effects still occur.
canonical_contracts.object_timer: First independently decrement object+E8 u16 by supplied master ticks, saturating at0; ticks>65535 clear it. This is not the game+E8 flight state.
canonical_contracts.automatic_phase: For game+E8==2, clear warning bit; object+FF<=0x1E sets retract and refreshes on every invocation; phase>0x1E clears retract and refreshes only if previously set.
canonical_contracts.speed_warning: Deploy request outside automatic flight state warns once at signed raw speed>=100000 and latches warning bit2. It does not block gear motion.
canonical_contracts.manual_toggle: Only object+FF==0x24 blocks this branch. Otherwise XOR request bit2, clear warning latch, set both console icons, refresh, play0x0C; every path plays0x14.
canonical_contracts.landing_position: Original six-instruction F575 predicate requires exact gear position0xFFFF as one condition; a request alone is insufficient and this is not full collision parity.
canonical_contracts.source_order: Verified F1009 slice calls F1008 before indirect active-state dispatch; the modern caller rate is a separate policy.
canonical_contracts.thermal_polarity: Existing source_atmospheric_dynamics.gear_down bool represents raw game+E9 bit2 despite its historical name: pass retract_request_bit, not physical deployment. No previous JSON is rewritten.

caller_policies.phone_rate_scope: Explicit named fixed60 phone adapter with persisted phase/rational master ticks; not proof of original DOS60Hz.

caller_policies.automatic_phase_scope: Phone landing/docking phase mapping must be named as an adapter; the original entire autopilot/state machine is not implied.
caller_policies.persistence_scope: A separate versioned landing-gear sibling owns request bit, position, warning/timer and scheduling state; previous thermal/fuel/hyperdrive resources stay immutable.
caller_policies.callback_scope: Icon/warning/refresh/sound callbacks are observed requests; full original GUI/audio/event dispatcher is outside extraction.
